en.title: UK Disability Work Support Cuts Threaten Creative Industry Accessibility
en.summary: The UK government’s cuts to the Access to Work scheme threaten workplace accommodations for disabled creatives, while new US federal rules mandate healthcare providers improve accessibility for patients with disabilities. Taiwan’s railway is upgrading seven stations with barrier‑free facilities, Kawasaki City launched a sign‑language link service for deaf users, and a study shows 95.9% of websites still fail accessibility tests.

zh-TW.title: 美國新規要求醫療提供者提升無障礙，影響殘障就醫
zh-TW.summary: 美國聯邦新規將對醫療提供者施加無障礙要求，同時英國削減Access to Work計畫威脅殘障創作者的職場支援。台灣台鐵將升級七站無障礙設施，川崎市推出手語連結服務，且一項研究顯示95.9%網站仍無法通過無障礙測試。
